snippet.title: Of Lies and Rain - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Step into the world and check out gameplay from Of Lies and Rain in this trailer for the story-driven first-person shooter built exclusively for VR. Set in a dark, sci-fi, post-apocalyptic world, you’ll fight to reclaim your past and save humanity from the brink of extinction. Of Lies and Rain will be available on Meta, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Steam.
